subject.title: fix(gateway): add separate inline avatar size cap for agents.list projection

question: Should accepted avatars above the inline budget be omitted from gateway agent summaries with emoji or initials fallback, or preserved through a bounded thumbnail or fetchable reference?
rationale: The implementation can bound the response either way, but the permanent client-visible fallback and acceptable aggregate payload budget require owner intent.

options.title: Approve bounded omission
options.body: Keep the narrow projection-only cap after fixing the read race and diagnostic, then require real multi-agent client fallback proof.

options.title: Require thumbnail or reference
options.body: Preserve avatar visibility through a bounded derivative or lazy fetch path before merging.

options.title: Retain full inlining
options.body: Decline the gateway cap and accept continued response growth and slow-link timeout risk.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded omission
recommendation.body: Keep the narrow projection-only cap after fixing the read race and diagnostic, then require real multi-agent client fallback proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Merged history and current-main blame connect this person most directly to both the avatar contract and gateway projection implementation.
